analytic_certificate.raw_mass_identity: For tautology-free canonical CNF with bipolar residual variables, RAW_S(x)=S-M_x+P_x and sum_x RAW_S(x)=V*S-L-sum_clause(|clause|^2)+sum_x P_x.
analytic_certificate.existence_consequence: min_x RAW_S(x) <= average_x RAW_S(x) <= T, so at least one pivot preserves both frozen post-transition inequalities before canonical NF; exact DP NF can only reduce the raw mass.

interpretation.what_AH_establishes: The exact average raw-mass identity gives a polynomially checkable sufficient pivot-existence certificate. On all 122 frozen root-reachable residual events in the AH domain, that certificate holds with positive slack, hence an admissible raw-DP pivot exists without using SAT truth.
interpretation.what_AH_does_not_establish: AH does not prove that every residual reachable from arbitrary CNF satisfies the average condition, does not prove the frozen invariant globally inductive, and does not prove a polynomial runtime bound for SAT.
